'''Bravo Six''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], operating on and around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] served as Bravo Six around the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and ultimately survived that conflict.
